description: This file defines configuration types, default constants, and resolver functions for the Firecrawl plugin within the openclaw project, handling API keys, URLs, and fetch/search settings.

methods.name: resolveSearchConfig
methods.description: Resolves the web search configuration from the provided OpenClawConfig object.

methods.name: resolveFetchConfig
methods.description: Resolves the web fetch configuration from the provided OpenClawConfig object.

methods.name: resolveFirecrawlSearchConfig
methods.description: Resolves the Firecrawl search configuration, prioritizing plugin config over general config.

methods.name: resolveFirecrawlFetchConfig
methods.description: Resolves the Firecrawl fetch configuration, prioritizing plugin config over general config.

methods.name: normalizeConfiguredSecret
methods.description: Normalizes secret input values with a specific path.

methods.name: resolveFirecrawlApiKey
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the API key for Firecrawl from config or environment.

methods.name: resolveFirecrawlBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for Firecrawl from config or environment.

methods.name: resolveFirecrawlOnlyMainContent
methods.description: Determines whether to fetch only main content, with override support.

methods.name: resolveFirecrawlMaxAgeMs
methods.description: Resolves the maximum age in milliseconds for cached data, with override support.

methods.name: resolveFirecrawlScrapeTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Resolves the timeout in seconds for scraping, with override support.

methods.name: resolveFirecrawlSearchTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Resolves the timeout in seconds for search, with override support.
